series.name: MOD 3-15KTL3-X (three-phase string, 2 MPPT)
series.notes: Grey/white 2-MPPT three-phase string inverter. Manual section 13.3 'System error' lists Error 200-308 and 400-425. The SAME 3-digit code table is reused across the newer MOD/MID TL3-H bodies, but descriptions differ slightly (see SERIES 3 WIT) - treat digit meaning per-series. Codes 423/424/602/608 exist on other Growatt bodies but were NOT in this manual, so they are not claimed here.

meaning.en: The AFCI arc-fault detector has tripped on the DC side. A tripped AFCI can only be cleared manually.
meaning.ur: DC side par AFCI ne arc detect kar ke apne aap band kar diya. Isay sirf manual tareeqe se reset karna hota hai.

causes.en: A real arc at a PV connector, module or DC cable
causes.ur: PV connector, module ya DC cable par asal arc

causes.en: Loose or burnt MC4 connector, or damaged DC insulation
causes.ur: Loose ya burnt MC4 connector, ya DC insulation damaged

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and wait 5 minutes before touching anything.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karein aur 5 minute wait karein, phir haath lagayein.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check the DC input voltage first (0 V expected).
solutions.ur: Multimeter se pehle DC input voltage check karein (0 V aana chahiye).

solutions.en: Inspect every MC4 pair and DC cable for heat marks, and re-crimp any loose connector.
solutions.ur: Har MC4 pair aur DC cable par garmi ke nishaan dekhein, aur loose connector dobara crimp karein.

meaning.en: The residual-current device measured leakage current above the permitted limit.
meaning.ur: Residual current device ne leakage current ki limit cross kar li.

causes.en: Moisture in PV connectors or junction boxes
causes.ur: PV connectors ya junction boxes mein nam

causes.en: Damaged cable insulation to PE, or poor panel-frame earthing
causes.ur: PE ke taraf cable insulation damaged, ya panel frame earthing kharab

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure PV+ to PE and PV- to PE insulation resistance with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir megohmmeter se PV+ se PE aur PV- se PE ka insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV strings one by one to find the leaking string.
solutions.ur: PV strings ko ek-ek karke disconnect karein taake leaking string pata chale.

solutions.en: Clean and dry the affected connectors, and re-torque the frame and PE earth lugs.
solutions.ur: Affected connectors ko saaf aur khushk karein, aur frame aur PE earth lugs dobara torque karein.

title.ur: DC input voltage maximum se zyada

meaning.en: PV string open-circuit voltage has gone above the inverter's maximum tolerable DC voltage.
meaning.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC voltage se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: String designed too long for the ambient minimum temperature (Voc rises in cold weather)
causes.ur: String minimum temperature ke liye lambi banayi gayi hai, thand mein Voc barh jata hai

causes.en: Two strings paralleled by mistake, or wrong DC switch
causes.ur: Do strings galti se parallel, ya ghalat DC switch

solutions.en: Open the DC switch immediately and measure string voltage on each MPPT.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran band karein aur har MPPT par string voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare measured Voc against the module datasheet Voc at the coldest expected temperature.
solutions.ur: Module datasheet ka Voc (sab se thande temperature par) se measured Voc compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of modules per string, or move the inverter to a model rated for that voltage.
solutions.ur: String mein modules ki sankhya kam karein, ya aisa inverter lagayein jo us voltage ke liye rated ho.

title.ur: PV isolation low - insulation fault aa gaya

meaning.en: Isolation resistance between the PV array and earth has fallen below the threshold.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan isolation resistance limit se neeche aa gaya.

causes.en: Wet panel backsheets or water inside the junction box / combiner
causes.ur: Geela panel backsheet ya junction box / combiner ke andar paani

causes.en: Chafed cable insulation touching the frame
causes.ur: Frame ko chhooti hui cable insulation

solutions.en: Do not touch the equipment - treat as a live earth fault. Isolate PV and AC first.
solutions.ur: Equipment ko haath na lagayein - zameen par live fault samajhein. Pehle PV aur AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: After shutdown, confirm the panel shell and mounting frame are reliably grounded.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad verify karein ke panel shell aur mounting frame achi tarah grounded hain.

solutions.en: Disconnect strings one at a time; the string that clears the alarm is the leaking one - then inspect it wet-side.
solutions.ur: Strings ko ek-ek karke disconnect karein; jis string par alarm hat jaye wahi leaking hai - usay geeli taraf se dekhein.

title.en: AC grid voltage out of range
title.ur: AC grid voltage range se bahar

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is outside the inverter's permissible window, so the unit will not connect.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ke allowable range se bahar hai, is liye unit connect nahi hoga.

causes.en: Grid voltage sag/surge from load steps or a weak LT distribution
causes.ur: Load switching ya kamzor LT distribution se grid voltage ka sag/surge

causes.en: Wrong country grid-code selected, or AC voltage set-point misconfigured
causes.ur: Ghalat country grid-code select hua, ya AC voltage set-point ghalat hai

solutions.en: Measure L-L and L-N voltage with a true-RMS multimeter at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par true-RMS multimeter se L-L aur L-N voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check AC wiring, especially neutral and PE, and re-torque the terminals.
solutions.ur: AC wiring check karein, khaas kar neutral aur PE, aur terminals dobara torque karein.

solutions.en: If grid voltage is inside the local standard, contact Growatt to confirm the grid-code setting.
solutions.ur: Agar grid voltage local standard ke andar hai, to Growatt se grid-code setting confirm karwayein.

meaning.en: Two AC line conductors are connected in the wrong phase order.
meaning.ur: Do AC line conductors galat phase order mein lage hain.

causes.en: Wiring error at the AC terminal block
causes.ur: AC terminal block par wiring galti

causes.en: Phase sequence of a three-phase supply swapped at the distribution board
causes.ur: Distribution board par three-phase supply ka sequence badal gaya

solutions.en: Switch off AC and PV, then confirm the phase order of the supply.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV band karein, phir supply ka phase order confirm karein.

solutions.en: Re-wire the AC terminals in the correct phase order and tighten to torque.
solutions.ur: AC terminals ko sahi phase order mein dobara lagayein aur torque karein.

title.en: No AC connection / grid power failure
title.ur: AC connection nahi hai / grid power failure

meaning.en: The inverter sees no AC input, so it stays in off-grid or standby state.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko koi AC input nahi mil raha, is liye woh off-grid ya standby mein rehta hai.

causes.en: AC breaker open or AC isolator switched off
causes.ur: AC breaker open ya AC isolator band

causes.en: Upstream distribution fuse blown after a load change
causes.ur: Load change ke baad upstream distribution fuse uth gaya

solutions.en: After shutdown, check AC wiring and the AC breaker's terminal tightness.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad AC wiring aur AC breaker ke terminal ki tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Verify grid presence at the AC terminal with a multimeter before restarting.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle multimeter se AC terminal par grid mojood check karein.

title.ur: NE abnormal (N aur PE ka voltage zyada)

meaning.en: Voltage difference between neutral and protective earth is out of limit; the manual shows this same code for the earth-fault alarm.
meaning.ur: Neutral aur protective earth ke darmiyan voltage difference limit se bahar hai; manual isi code ko earth-fault alarm ke liye bhi dikhata hai.

causes.en: Broken or loose PE conductor between inverter and earth pit
causes.ur: Inverter aur earth pit ke darmiyan PE conductor toota ya loose

causes.en: Neutral and PE swapped at the AC terminal
causes.ur: AC terminal par neutral aur PE swap ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure the N-to-PE voltage; it must be near 0 V.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir N se PE voltage measure karein; ye qareeb 0 V hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check that the PE cable is solidly connected at the inverter lug and the earth pit.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke PE cable inverter lug aur earth pit dono par mazboot se lagi ho.

solutions.en: If the earth fault alarm is active, do not touch the unit - have the array insulation tested.
solutions.ur: Agar earth fault alarm active hai to unit ko haath na lagayein - array ka insulation test karwayein.

title.en: AC grid frequency out of range
title.ur: AC grid frequency range se bahar

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the inverter's permissible window, so grid connection is blocked.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency inverter ke allowable range se bahar hai, is liye grid connection block hai.

causes.en: Generator or weak grid pulling frequency outside limits
causes.ur: Generator ya kamzor grid frequency ko limit se bahar le raha hai

causes.en: Local grid standard differs from the configured setting
causes.ur: Local grid standard configured setting se alag hai

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency with a multimeter or clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter ya clamp meter se grid frequency measure karein.

solutions.en: Check AC wiring, especially neutral and ground wire, and re-torque.
solutions.ur: AC wiring check karein, khaas kar neutral aur ground wire, aur dobara torque karein.

solutions.en: Restart once; if frequency is normal and the code returns, contact Growatt.
solutions.ur: Ek baar restart karein; agar frequency normal hai aur code wapas aata hai to Growatt se rabta karein.

title.ur: Load rated power se upar chala gaya

meaning.en: Output load exceeded the inverter's rated power, so it shut down.
meaning.ur: Output load inverter ki rated power se zyada ho gaya, is liye unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Connected load exceeds the inverter kW rating
causes.ur: Connected load inverter ke kW rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Motor or compressor with high inrush current on the AC side
causes.ur: AC side par high inrush current wala motor ya compressor

solutions.en: List every load on the AC side and add up the running wattage.
solutions.ur: AC side ki tamam loads list karein aur running wattage ka total nikalein.

solutions.en: Switch off the largest non-essential load and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Sab se bada ghair-zaroori load band karein aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Stagger large motor starts or move the load to a larger inverter.
solutions.ur: Bade motors ki starting stagger karein ya load bade inverter par shift karein.

title.ur: CT ka L aur N ulat palt hai

meaning.en: The current transformer L and N conductors are connected in reverse.
meaning.ur: Current transformer ke L aur N conductors ulat se lage hain.

causes.en: CT installed with L and N swapped at the CT terminal
causes.ur: CT terminal par L aur N swap karke CT lagaya gaya

causes.en: CT wired to the wrong phase after a wiring change
causes.ur: Wiring badalne ke baad CT galat phase se jorr diya gaya

solutions.en: Switch off AC and PV, then check the SP-CT connection at the CT terminal.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV band karein, phir CT terminal par SP-CT connection check karein.

solutions.en: Swap the CT L and N conductors and tighten the terminal screws.
solutions.ur: CT ke L aur N conductors swap karein aur terminal screws kasa dein.

title.en: M3 did not receive SP-CT data
title.ur: M3 ko SP-CT ka data nahi mila

meaning.en: The communication board is not receiving data from the smart meter / CT module.
meaning.ur: Communication board ko smart meter / CT module se data nahi mil raha.

causes.en: RS485 cable loose, swapped A/B, or not shielded
causes.ur: RS485 cable loose, A/B swap, ya shield nahi

causes.en: Meter or CT module not powered
causes.ur: Meter ya CT module ko power nahi mil raha

solutions.en: After shutdown, reseat the RS485 cable at both the inverter and the meter ends.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad inverter aur meter dono taraf RS485 cable dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Confirm A connects to A and B to B, then tighten both ends.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke A se A aur B se B jora gaya hai, phir dono ends kasa dein.

solutions.en: Check the meter is powered and its address matches the inverter setting.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter powered hai aur uska address inverter setting se match karta hai.

title.ur: Communication pairing ka waqt zyada ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter could not finish pairing with the meter/logger within the allowed time.
meaning.ur: Inverter meter/logger ke saath pairing allotted time mein complete nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Smart meter not in pairing mode, or too far away
causes.ur: Smart meter pairing mode mein nahi, ya bohat door hai

causes.en: Other devices competing on the same RS485 bus
causes.ur: Ek hi RS485 bus par doosre devices mojood hain

solutions.en: Power-cycle the meter to put it back into pairing mode.
solutions.ur: Meter ka power cycle karein taake woh dobara pairing mode mein aaye.

solutions.en: Bring the meter close to the inverter during pairing, then move it back.
solutions.ur: Pairing ke waqt meter ko inverter ke paas laayein, phir wapas move karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and start the pairing once only one meter is on the bus.
solutions.ur: Bus par sirf ek meter hone ke baad inverter restart karke pairing karein.

meaning.en: The DC injection current detector has detected a bias outside its allowed window.
meaning.ur: DC injection current detector ne allowed range se bahar bias detect kiya.

causes.en: GFCI module or its zero-crossing reference has drifted
causes.ur: GFCI module ya uska zero-crossing reference bekar chala hai

causes.en: Noisy DC cable routing picking up interference
causes.ur: Noisy DC cable routing se interference aa raha hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see if the code clears.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke code hat jaata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it returns, isolate the DC side and re-check PE and PV insulation resistance.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to DC side isolate karke PE aur PV insulation resistance dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Keep the DC and AC runs separated in the conduit to reduce induced noise.
solutions.ur: Conduit mein DC aur AC runs alag rakhein taake induced noise kam ho.

meaning.en: Internal DC bus voltage is above the safe threshold during operation.
meaning.ur: Chalta hua bus voltage safe threshold se upar hai.

causes.en: Grid outage while PV keeps feeding a raised bus voltage
causes.ur: Grid chala gaya aur PV bus voltage barhata raha

causes.en: Grid-code voltage set-point set too high for local conditions
causes.ur: Grid-code voltage set-point local conditions ke liye bohat high set hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once grid is stable.
solutions.ur: Grid stable hone ke baad inverter ek baar restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the grid voltage set-point and country profile in the settings.
solutions.ur: Settings mein grid voltage set-point aur country profile check karein.

solutions.en: If the code returns with normal grid, send the fault log to Growatt service.
solutions.ur: Agar normal grid ke saath code wapas aaye to fault log Growatt service ko bhejein.

meaning.en: DC component injected into the AC output is above the permitted limit.
meaning.ur: AC output mein inject hua DC component allowed limit se zyada hai.

causes.en: Leakage or a failing filter capacitor in the output stage
causes.ur: Output stage mein leakage ya filter capacitor kharab

causes.en: Grid-side EMI or a poor neutral connection
causes.ur: Grid side EMI ya neutral connection kharab

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the code returns, isolate AC and check the filter board.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; code wapas aaye to AC isolate karke filter board check karein.

solutions.en: Measure N-to-PE voltage and confirm PE is solid at the AC terminal.
solutions.ur: N se PE voltage measure karein aur AC terminal par PE mazboot hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Escalate to Growatt service with the fault log - DCI faults usually need board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Fault log ke saath Growatt service ko refer karein - DCI fault aam tor par board level repair maangte hain.

meaning.en: The three phase output currents are not equal to each other.
meaning.ur: Teen phase ke output currents aapas mein barabar nahi hain.

causes.en: Single-phase load connected heavily on one phase
causes.ur: Kisi aik phase par single-phase load zyada lagi ho

causes.en: Loose or high-resistance terminal in one phase leg
causes.ur: Kisi aik phase leg ka terminal loose ya zyada resistance wala ho

solutions.en: After shutdown, check each phase current at the AC terminal with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad clamp meter se AC terminal par har phase ka current check karein.

solutions.en: Re-torque all three phase terminals and check for a burnt contact.
solutions.ur: Teenon phase terminals dobara torque karein aur burnt contact dekhein.

solutions.en: Rebalance the load across the three phases, then restart.
solutions.ur: Load ko teenon phases mein balance karein, phir restart karein.

meaning.en: The internal bus voltage sampling circuit is reporting an implausible value.
meaning.ur: Internal bus voltage sampling circuit se unreasonable value aa raha hai.

causes.en: Sampling feedback resistor or reference drifted on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par sampling feedback resistor ya reference bekar chala hai

causes.en: Loose ribbon cable between control board and sampling module
causes.ur: Control board aur sampling module ke darmiyan ribbon cable loose hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and note whether the code is repeatable.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur note karein ke code dobara aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If repeatable, isolate AC and PV, then reseat the control-board ribbon cables.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to AC aur PV isolate karke control board ke ribbon cables dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Send the fault log to Growatt service for board-level diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Board level diagnosis ke liye fault log Growatt service ko bhejein.

meaning.en: The grid connection relay is not switching or its feedback does not confirm the state.
meaning.ur: Grid connection relay switch nahi ho raha ya uska feedback state confirm nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Relay coil or contact burnt, often after an arc-fault trip
causes.ur: Relay coil ya contact burnt, aksar arc-fault trip ke baad

causes.en: Relay PCB driver transistor failed
causes.ur: Relay PCB ka driver transistor fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then listen for the relay click when the AC breaker is toggled.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir AC breaker on/off karte waqt relay ki click check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once; a single click and code cleared means an interlock event.
solutions.ur: Ek baar restart karein; sirf ek click aur code clear ho jaye to interlock event tha.

solutions.en: If the relay never clicks, the relay or its driver board must be replaced - log it for Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar relay kabhi click na kare to relay ya uska driver board badalna parega - Growatt warranty ke liye note karein.

title.ur: Init model fault - dip switch setting ghalat hai

meaning.en: The dip switches underneath the inverter do not match the fitted model, so initialisation fails.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke neeche ke dip switches fitted model se match nahi karte, is liye initialisation fail hai.

causes.en: Dip switch block moved during servicing or transport
causes.ur: Servicing ya transport ke doraan dip switch block hila diya gaya

causes.en: Control board replaced without re-setting the model
causes.ur: Control board badla gaya aur model setting dobara nahi ki gayi

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then read the dip switch positions under the unit.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karein, phir unit ke neeche dip switch ki positions padhein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading with the model table in the manual and reset the block to match.
solutions.ur: Reading ko manual ke model table se compare karein aur block ko usi ke mutabiq set karein.

solutions.en: Power the unit up again in reset mode; if the code returns the board model data is wrong.
solutions.ur: Unit ko reset mode mein dobara power karein; code wapas aaye to board ka model data ghalat hai.

meaning.en: The inverter's pre-connection self-test did not complete successfully.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka connection se pehle ka self-test safai se complete nahi hua.

causes.en: Grid parameters not yet stable during the self-test window
causes.ur: Self-test ke dauran grid parameters abhi stable nahi hue

causes.en: AFCI self-test loop or DC insulation failing the test
causes.ur: AFCI self-test loop ya DC insulation test fail kar raha hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter while the grid is healthy and stable.
solutions.ur: Grid theek aur stable ho tab inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Run the ARC reset button test for 3-5 seconds and re-run auto test.
solutions.ur: ARC reset button ko 3-5 second tak dabayein aur auto test dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: If auto test keeps failing, check PV insulation and then raise a service request.
solutions.ur: Agar auto test baar baar fail ho to PV insulation check karke service request karein.

meaning.en: The inverter has shut down on an over-temperature condition detected by the NTC sensor.
meaning.ur: NTC sensor ne over-temperature detect kiya aur inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Blocked airflow, dust build-up on the heatsink, or ambient temperature too high
causes.ur: Airflow block, heatsink par dhool, ya ambient temperature bohat zyada

causes.en: NTC sensor unplugged or reading falsely high
causes.ur: NTC sensor ka plug nahi hua ya reading ghalat high hai

solutions.en: After shutdown, check that the temperature sampling module is connected properly.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke temperature sampling module theek se laga hua hai.

solutions.en: Measure the inverter temperature; if it is below 60 C the reading is likely a sensor problem.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka temperature measure karein; agar 60 C se neeche hai to reading ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Clean the heatsink and restore clearance, then let it cool fully before restart.
solutions.ur: Heatsink saaf karein aur clearance wapas karein, phir poori tarah thanda hone dein.

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage is outside its normal operating window.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage apne normal operating window se bahar hai.

causes.en: Capacitor ageing or DC link ripple above tolerance
causes.ur: Capacitor aging ya DC link ripple tolerance se zyada

causes.en: Grid voltage step causing a hard bus excursion
causes.ur: Grid voltage step se bus mein sudden excursion

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and watch whether the code appears immediately at every start.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke kya code har start par foran aata hai.

solutions.en: If immediate, isolate AC and PV and check the DC link capacitors for bulging or leakage.
solutions.ur: Agar foran aaye to AC aur PV isolate karke DC link capacitors bulging ya leakage ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Send the fault log to Growatt service - frequent 409 usually points to the mainboard.
solutions.ur: Fault log Growatt service ko bhejein - baar baar 409 aam tor par mainboard ki taraf ishara karta hai.

aliases: Communication board and control panel sampling battery voltage is inconsistent

title.en: Comm board vs control panel battery sample mismatch
title.ur: Comm board aur control panel ki battery sample mein farq hai

meaning.en: The communication board and the control panel are sampling the battery at different values.
meaning.ur: Communication board aur control panel battery ko alag alag values par sample kar rahe hain.

causes.en: Communication board M3 not seated correctly or faulty
causes.ur: Communication board M3 theek se baitha nahi ya faulty hai

causes.en: Battery voltage genuinely fluctuating between samples
causes.ur: Battery voltage samples ke darmiyan asal mein fluctuate kar rahi ho

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once and note if the code is intermittent.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar restart karein aur note karein ke code intermittent hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the terminals with a multimeter and compare it to the app reading.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se terminals par battery voltage measure karke app reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the two readings never agree, reseat or replace the M3 board under Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar dono readings kabhi match na hon to M3 board dobara baithayein ya Growatt warranty ke teht badlein.

meaning.en: The DSP on the communication board is not communicating correctly with the control board.
meaning.ur: Communication board ka DSP control board se theek se communicate nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Loose communication-board wiring or ribbon cable
causes.ur: Communication board wiring ya ribbon cable loose

causes.en: DSP and M3 firmware versions do not match
causes.ur: DSP aur M3 firmware versions match nahi karte

solutions.en: After shutdown, check the communication board wiring and reseat every connector.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad communication board wiring check karein aur har connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Read the DSP and M3 firmware versions and update both to the matched pair.
solutions.ur: DSP aur M3 firmware versions padhein aur dono ko matched pair par update karein.

solutions.en: If the code survives an update, swap the M3 board and claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar update ke baad bhi code rahe to M3 board badal kar warranty claim karein.

title.ur: Temperature sensor module nahi laga hua

meaning.en: The temperature sampling module is unplugged or its connection has failed.
meaning.ur: Temperature sampling module ka plug nahi hua ya uska connection fail hai.

causes.en: NTC sensor connector not seated after fan or board service
causes.ur: Fan ya board service ke baad NTC sensor connector baitha nahi

causes.en: Sensor cable pinched or cut during assembly
causes.ur: Assembly ke dauran sensor cable daba ya kata gaya

solutions.en: After shutdown, check that the temperature sampling module is connected properly.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke temperature sampling module theek se laga hua hai.

solutions.en: Reseat the NTC connector and inspect the cable for a break along its route.
solutions.ur: NTC connector dobara baithayein aur cable mein toot ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace the NTC sensor if the reading stays high with a new one fitted.
solutions.ur: Naya sensor lagane par bhi reading high rahe to NTC sensor badal dein.

meaning.en: The gate drive to the power IGBT module has failed or the module has failed.
meaning.ur: Power IGBT module ka gate drive fail hai ya module hi fail ho gaya.

causes.en: IGBT module or its gate drive PCB has failed
causes.ur: IGBT module ya uska gate drive PCB fail hai

causes.en: DC bus over-voltage from an earlier fault damaging the module
causes.ur: Pehle ke kisi fault se DC bus over-voltage ne module kharab kiya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely before any inspection - never probe a live IGBT.
solutions.ur: Check karne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah isolate karein - live IGBT par kabhi probe na karein.

solutions.en: Restart once; if the code returns, do not power-cycle repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Ek baar restart karein; code wapas aaye to baar baar on/off na karein.

solutions.en: Send the fault log to Growatt for board replacement under warranty.
solutions.ur: Warranty ke teht board badalwane ke liye fault log Growatt ko bhejein.

meaning.en: The control board cannot read or write the settings memory (EEPROM).
meaning.ur: Control board settings memory (EEPROM) parh ya likh nahi sakta.

causes.en: EEPROM chip or its I2C solder joint on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par EEPROM chip ya uska I2C solder joint

causes.en: Power loss during a settings write corrupting the memory
causes.ur: Settings write ke dauran power chala jane se memory corrupt

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then wait 5 minutes so bus capacitors discharge.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein taake bus capacitors discharge hon.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the EEPROM error only appears in the morning it is usually a marginal chip.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; agar EEPROM error sirf subah aata hai to aam tor par marginal chip hota hai.

solutions.en: If the fault is sustained, the control board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar fault barqarar rahe to control board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

aliases: Internal power test fail (PV Power low)

title.en: Internal power self-test fail (PV power low)
title.ur: Internal power ka self-test fail - PV power kam tha

meaning.en: The inverter's internal power supply self-test failed because PV power was too low.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka internal power supply self-test fail hua kyunke PV power kam thi.

causes.en: PV power below the minimum needed to boot the control supply
causes.ur: PV power control supply boot karne ke liye minimum se neeche

causes.en: Very low or falling battery SOC on a hybrid unit
causes.ur: Hybrid unit par battery SOC bohat kam ya gir raha hai

solutions.en: Wait for clear midday sun and confirm PV power on the app before restarting.
solutions.ur: Dopahar ke saaf dhoop ka intezaar karein aur restart se pehle app par PV power confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV string voltage; it must be above the start voltage on the label.
solutions.ur: PV string voltage measure karein; ye label par diye start voltage se upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If PV is healthy and the code persists, raise a service request for the auxiliary supply.
solutions.ur: Agar PV theek hai aur code phir bhi hai to auxiliary supply ke liye service request karein.

title.ur: Software protection ne over-current rok diya

meaning.en: Firmware over-current protection tripped and the inverter shut down.
meaning.ur: Firmware ka over-current protection trigger hua aur inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Sustained overload or a shorted output stage
causes.ur: Lamba overload ya shorted output stage

causes.en: Grid fault such as a phase loss or very low grid voltage
causes.ur: Grid fault jaise phase loss ya bohat kam grid voltage

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check for a short with a multimeter on the AC output.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir AC output par multimeter se short check karein.

solutions.en: Restart once with the load disconnected to see if the code clears.
solutions.ur: Load disconnect kar ke ek baar restart karein taake pata chale code clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the code returns with no load, send the log to Growatt for board-level service.
solutions.ur: Agar load ke baghair code wapas aaye to log Growatt ko bhejein board level service ke liye.

meaning.en: The two redundant grid-voltage samples do not agree with each other.
meaning.ur: Do redundant grid-voltage samples aapas mein match nahi kar rahi.

causes.en: One voltage sampling channel has drifted
causes.ur: Kisi aik voltage sampling channel ka reading bekar chala hai

causes.en: Intermittent contact in the sampling board connector
causes.ur: Sampling board connector mein contact kabhi kabhi nahi lagta

solutions.en: Restart the machine once and record the time of day the code appears.
solutions.ur: Machine ek baar restart karein aur note karein ke code din ke kis waqt aata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and reseat the sampling board connector, then check each phase voltage separately.
solutions.ur: AC isolate karke sampling board connector dobara baithayein, phir har phase voltage alag measure karein.

solutions.en: If one channel still reads high, the sampling board needs replacing - claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar ek channel phir bhi high de to sampling board badalna parega - warranty claim karein.

aliases: DSP and COM firmware version unmatch

title.en: DSP and COM firmware version mismatch
title.ur: DSP aur COM firmware version mismatch hai

meaning.en: The DSP firmware and the communication board firmware are not the same release.
meaning.ur: DSP firmware aur communication board firmware ek hi release ke nahi hain.

causes.en: One board was updated or replaced without the other
causes.ur: Ek board update ya replace hua aur doosra nahi hua

causes.en: Firmware upload interrupted part way through
causes.ur: Firmware upload beech mein ruk gaya

solutions.en: Read both firmware versions and note them before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi badalne se pehle dono firmware versions padhein aur note kar lein.

solutions.en: Update the DSP and COM firmware as one matched pair from the Growatt download centre.
solutions.ur: DSP aur COM firmware ko Growatt download centre se ek matched pair ke tor par update karein.

solutions.en: After updating, power-cycle and confirm the version pair matches on the app.
solutions.ur: Update ke baad power-cycle karke app par confirm karein ke version pair match karta hai.

meaning.en: The leakage current samples from the two channels disagree.
meaning.ur: Dono channels ke leakage current samples aapas mein match nahi karte.

causes.en: Current transformer on the leakage detection path has drifted
causes.ur: Leakage detection path ke current transformer ka reading bekar chala hai

causes.en: Sampling resistor or filter capacitor aged on the GFCI board
causes.ur: GFCI board par sampling resistor ya filter capacitor aging ho gaya

solutions.en: Restart the machine once; an intermittent code points to a marginal sensor.
solutions.ur: Machine ek baar restart karein; intermittent code marginal sensor ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: Check PV insulation and earth continuity to rule out a real earth fault first.
solutions.ur: Pehle asal earth fault hatane ke liye PV insulation aur earth continuity check karein.

solutions.en: If the code stays, the GFCI board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar code bacha rahe to GFCI board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

meaning.en: The ground fault circuit interrupter module is physically damaged.
meaning.ur: Ground fault circuit interrupter module physically kharab hai.

causes.en: GFCI module damaged by a surge or repeated leakage trips
causes.ur: Surge ya baar baar leakage trips se GFCI module kharab

causes.en: Water ingress into the wiring box reaching the GFCI board
causes.ur: Wiring box mein paani aa kar GFCI board tak pahunchna

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the leakage current module for burn or water marks.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke leakage current module par burnt ya paani ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure the array insulation resistance to rule out a genuine earth fault.
solutions.ur: Asal earth fault rule out karne ke liye array ka insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Replace the power/GFCI board if the module is damaged - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar module kharab ho to power/GFCI board badlein - Growatt warranty claim karein.

meaning.en: The complex programmable logic device on the control board is not operating normally.
meaning.ur: Control board ka CPLD normal tarah se kaam nahi kar raha.

causes.en: CPLD IC solder or device failure on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par CPLD IC solder ya device fail

causes.en: Auxiliary supply ripple upsetting the CPLD reference
causes.ur: Auxiliary supply ripple CPLD reference ko disturb kar raha hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then wait 5 minutes for the bus to discharge.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein taake bus discharge ho.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the code returns immediately it is a board-level failure.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; code foran wapas aaye to board level failure hai.

solutions.en: Send the log to Growatt for control board replacement under warranty.
solutions.ur: Warranty ke teht control board badalwane ke liye log Growatt ko bhejein.

meaning.en: The redundant sampling channels are returning different values.
meaning.ur: Redundant sampling channels alag alag values de rahe hain.

causes.en: One redundancy sampling channel drifted
causes.ur: Kisi aik redundancy sampling channel bekar chala hai

causes.en: Sampling reference supply out of tolerance
causes.ur: Sampling reference supply tolerance se bahar hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and check whether the fault is consistent or intermittent.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke check karein ke fault consistent hai ya intermittent.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and reseat both sampling channels, then compare readings on the app.
solutions.ur: AC isolate karke dono sampling channels dobara baithayein, phir app par readings compare karein.

solutions.en: If channels never agree, replace the control board under warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar channels kabhi match na hon to warranty ke teht control board badlein.

meaning.en: The AFCI failed its own internal self-test, so protection cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: AFCI ka apna internal self-test fail hua, is liye protection par bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta.

causes.en: AFCI board fault or a self-test loop wiring problem
causes.ur: AFCI board fault ya self-test loop wiring ki masla

causes.en: Intermittent DC contact upsetting the self-test current
causes.ur: DC contact kabhi kabhi na lagne se self-test current disturb hota hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and let the AFCI self-test run again.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur AFCI self-test dobara chalne dein.

solutions.en: Inspect and reseat the DC connectors, since a loose connector also fails self-test.
solutions.ur: DC connectors check karke dobara baithayein, kyunke loose connector bhi self-test fail karata hai.

solutions.en: If self-test still fails, the AFCI board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar self-test phir bhi fail ho to AFCI board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.
